metadata.title: Product Bricks & Capabilities
metadata.description: Three-level product brick map for the internet-number-registry-and-routing-trust domain.

rootGroups.name: Registry Resource Management
rootGroups.description: Allocate, assign, transfer, maintain, and validate Internet number resources and registry data.

subGroups.name: Allocation and Assignment
subGroups.description: Core workflows for IPv4, IPv6, and AS Number resource distribution.

bricks.name: IPv4 Allocation and Waiting List
bricks.description: Handles scarce IPv4 allocation, /24 waiting list progression, eligibility checks, queue transparency, and member notifications.

internalModules.title: IPv4 allocation workflow service
internalModules.description: Evaluates requests, queue state, eligibility, returned address pools, and allocation outcomes.

interfaces.title: IPv4 request and waiting list API
interfaces.description: Programmatic and LIR Portal interface for IPv4 request status and allocation actions.

brickDependencies.description: Uses member account standing and LIR account state to validate request eligibility.

dataDependencies.description: Creates and updates IPv4 resource registration records.
Publishes audit events for allocation decisions.

bricks.name: IPv6 Allocation and PI Assignment
bricks.description: Supports IPv6 allocations, PI assignments, IXP assignments, allocation extensions, and adoption guidance.

internalModules.title: IPv6 request workflow service
internalModules.description: Coordinates request validation, prefix sizing, documentation, and registry updates.

interfaces.title: IPv6 resource request API
interfaces.description: Portal and API workflow for IPv6 allocations and assignments.

brickDependencies.description: Exposes IPv6 request tasks through the authenticated member workspace.

dataDependencies.description: Creates and updates IPv6 resource registration records.
Publishes audit events for request decisions.

bricks.name: AS Number Registry
bricks.description: Assigns and maintains AS Numbers, routing policy references, ASN fee status, and registry data quality controls.

internalModules.title: ASN lifecycle service
internalModules.description: Manages ASN request, assignment, sponsorship, update, and retirement workflows.

interfaces.title: AS Number Registry API
interfaces.description: API used by portal, Whois, and routing security workflows to validate AS Number state.

brickDependencies.description: Provides ASN context used in certification and routing authorization workflows.

dataDependencies.description: Creates and updates AS Number registration records.

subGroups.name: Transfers and Registry Quality
subGroups.description: Keep registry records accurate through transfer, due diligence, review, and contact-quality workflows.

bricks.name: Resource Transfers and Mergers
bricks.description: Processes intra-RIR transfers, inter-RIR transfers, mergers, acquisitions, and resource-holder change requests.

internalModules.title: Transfer case management service
internalModules.description: Coordinates request evidence, parties, due diligence, approvals, and registry updates.

interfaces.title: Transfer request workspace
interfaces.description: Member and operations interface for transfer cases and requested evidence.

brickDependencies.description: Uses member account, role, and documentation state before registry state changes.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Coordinates transfers when resources move between RIR service regions.

dataDependencies.description: Stores transfer and merger request evidence and decision state.
Updates holder, status, and registry metadata when approved.

bricks.name: Assisted Registry Check
bricks.description: Provides proactive registry data reviews, member guidance, correction tracking, and evidence of registry accuracy improvement.

internalModules.title: ARC review workflow
internalModules.description: Schedules reviews, tracks issues, records member responses, and closes remediation items.

interfaces.title: ARC operations dashboard
interfaces.description: Internal and member-facing surface for registry review status and actions.

brickDependencies.description: Publishes correction tasks into the member portal.

dataDependencies.description: Stores ARC review findings and remediation state.

bricks.name: Abuse Contact Registry
bricks.description: Maintains abuse-c contact data, validation workflows, and consumer access paths for incident reporters and network operators.

internalModules.title: Abuse contact validation service
internalModules.description: Checks contact existence, freshness, and validation outcomes for registered resources.

interfaces.title: Abuse contact lookup API
interfaces.description: Lookup and validation interface for abuse contact information.

brickDependencies.description: Makes abuse contact signals visible in public lookup and analysis tools.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.system: Incident response and abuse reporting tools
externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.description: Use abuse contact data to route incident reports.

dataDependencies.description: Maintains abuse contact state tied to number resources.

subGroups.name: Registry Publication and Access Control
subGroups.description: Publish registry data through RIPE Database, Whois, RDAP, and APIs while protecting object maintenance authority.

bricks.name: RIPE Database and RDAP Publication
bricks.description: Maintains and publishes RIPE Database objects, Whois/RDAP lookup, route and route6 objects, organisation objects, contacts, and related public registry views.

internalModules.title: RIPE Database publication service
internalModules.description: Publishes public registry, RIPE IRR, reverse delegation, contact, and object metadata through Whois, web search, REST, and RDAP surfaces.

interfaces.title: Whois, REST, and RDAP interfaces
interfaces.description: Public and authenticated access paths for registry objects and related operational metadata.

brickDependencies.description: Publishes IPv4 resource records and lifecycle state into public registry views.
Publishes IPv6 resource records and lifecycle state into public registry views.
Publishes AS Number records, routing references, and related public object state.
Uses maintainer and access-control state to authorize object updates.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: IANA and peer RIR public data feeds
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Provides global RIR and IANA context used in public registry and statistics surfaces.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.system: Network automation, abuse desks, researchers, and public lookup tools
externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.interface: Whois, RDAP, REST API, and bulk data
externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.description: Use published registry objects for coordination, incident response, routing policy checks, and research.

dataDependencies.description: Maintains and publishes public registry, routing registry, and reverse delegation object state.
Reads authoritative resource lifecycle state for public object publication.
Publishes telemetry for Whois, RDAP, REST, and bulk data access.

bricks.name: Maintainer and Access Control
bricks.description: Controls update authority for RIPE Database objects through maintainers, role mappings, authentication state, API keys, and audited permission checks.

internalModules.title: Maintainer authorization service
internalModules.description: Evaluates object update authority, role memberships, authentication methods, API credentials, and audit events.

interfaces.title: Maintainer authorization API
interfaces.description: Authorization interface used by RIPE Database, LIR Portal, registry workflows, and API clients.

brickDependencies.description: Uses membership, LIR account, and role state to determine authorized maintainers.
Exposes maintainer and access-control tasks through the member workspace.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.interface: SSO, account roles, and authentication factors
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Provides authenticated user identity and account lifecycle state.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.system: Member automation and registry update clients
externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.interface: API keys and authenticated update flows
externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.description: Use maintainer authority to safely automate object updates.

dataDependencies.description: Maintains object authorization, maintainer, role, and credential metadata.
Reads member and role context used for authorization decisions.
Publishes audited authorization and object update events.

rootGroups.name: Member Services and Governance
rootGroups.description: Operate the member relationship, billing model, policy process, and training/certification ecosystem.

subGroups.name: Membership Operations

bricks.name: LIR Portal Workspace

internalModules.title: LIR Portal application

interfaces.title: LIR Portal UI

dataDependencies.description: Reads member profile, contacts, roles, and service entitlements.

bricks.name: Membership Lifecycle

interfaces.title: Membership API

dataDependencies.description: Maintains member organization, LIR account, role, and status data.

bricks.name: Billing and Charging Scheme

internalModules.title: Billing calculation service

interfaces.title: Billing account API

subGroups.name: Policy and Learning

bricks.description: Tracks policy proposals, discussion phases, implementation status, community input, and secretariat support for RIPE working groups.

internalModules.title: Policy proposal tracker

interfaces.title: Policy status publication API

bricks.name: Certified Professionals
bricks.description: Manages exam scheduling, voucher workflows, credentials, and skills validation for BGP security, IPv6, LIR, and database knowledge.

internalModules.title: Certification credential service
internalModules.description: Manages exam eligibility, credential issuance, and verification records.

interfaces.title: Credential verification API

rootGroups.name: Routing Trust and DNS
rootGroups.description: Secure routing through RPKI and operate authoritative DNS and root-service infrastructure.

subGroups.name: RPKI and Routing Security
subGroups.description: Certify resource holders and publish route authorization data that supports BGP origin validation.

brickDependencies.description: Validates resource holdings before certification.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Publishes objects consumed by validators and operators.

subGroups.name: DNS and Root Services
subGroups.description: Operate reverse DNS, authoritative DNS, K-root, and DNS monitoring services.
